svg.title: Active-Active · Sentinel mode · Three datacenters
svg.desc: Datacenters A, B and C have Service IDs 0, 1 and 2. Each has a local application, a Primary, a Replica and its own replication proxy. Each Primary feeds its own proxy, which serves both peer Primaries. All three pairs replicate in both directions: A to B, B to A, A to C, C to A, B to C and C to B. Proxies do not connect to one another. Gossip discovers all three members. Sentinel monitoring is omitted.
svg.text: Three datacenters · Every member accepts local reads and writes
Gossip membership — seeds bootstrap, then all three members discover each other
Six independent Oplog streams: one in each direction for A–B, A–C and B–C. Each peer pulls through the source datacenter's own proxy.
RDB: snapshot · Oplog: operation log. A group holds up to 16 members. Service IDs are illustrative; Sentinel monitoring is omitted.
